notes: «كنت أقود رجلا أعمى» is the narrator's scene: the blind man is not a link
«فانتهيت إلى عكرمة فأنشأ يحدثنا» — Ikrima narrates to them and transmits Ibn Abbas's report, so he is a link
The last link is the Companion Ibn Abbas; the Prophet is not a link

fixes.reason: K6I's index goes from عثمان الشحام straight to Ibn Abbas and omits Ikrima, whom the text names between them; HKG and RWY both carry him.

evidence.quote: فأنشأ يحدثنا قال حدثني ابن عباس
عثمان الشحام العدوي أبو سلمة البصري يقال
